death-becomes-her-2024.notes: Death Becomes Her opened November 21, 2024 at the Lunt-Fontanne Theatre with a capitalization of $31.5 million, making it one of the most expensive Broadway musicals to date. A January 2025 BroadwayWorld article described it as 'one of the major commercial successes of the season thus far.' A forum discussion (week ending Oct 12, 2025) cites running costs of $1,050,000/week and estimates weekly profit around $167,000, with one user projecting recoupment around spring 2026. However, the show closed June 28, 2026 without an explicit confirmed recoupment announcement in the evidence provided. A YouTube video from May 2026 asks 'why is Death Becomes Her closing,' suggesting the closure may have been earlier than originally hoped. Recoupment cannot be confirmed from the available evidence. Given the open-ended commercial run, strong grosses, and description as a major commercial success, but lacking confirmed recoupment, designation is TBD — however, given the closing date of June 2026 and the forum projection of recoupment in spring 2026, it is plausible the show recouped or came close; still, without explicit confirmation, Windfall is assigned cautiously based on strong performance indicators and an open-ended run that closed after roughly 18 months.
